title: Thai Film Industries PCL — claimed by thegentlemen
description: TH · Other · thaifilmind.com Thai Film Industries PCL (TFI) is a Thai film maker founded in 1983 (originally Rachadachai O.P.P. Co., Ltd.) by industrialist Prayudh Mahagitsiri — Thailand's first BOPP film producer and Southeast Asia's industry pioneer, today a global top-20 BOPP manufacturer.
